a1a23009.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

0b2d8d59.text: It is something else. I am not hearing it

48700ee7.text: I think that’s a good way to start the day.

77a095e6.text: How about you call yourself out for what you do?

3b9626c2.text: the switch says, after a while:

b420c6b4.text: I thought that’s what I was doing.

83fd882c.text: But why are you always doing things for yourself?

2cc86fad.text: I don’t know. It is easier when I do them all.

dea78091.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

28053d20.text: Well then, it's easier with you than it is for anyone else.

94878286.text: I agree. I like it better that way, too. I really do.

063e4530.text: Do you get bored with this, then?

3307a614.text: the switch says, after a while:

581d3bab.text: I never said it was boring. I just said I like it this way.

297ca588.text: So if i'm always doing it, what is this’t worth to me?

2c41187f.text: What makes you think that I should care? I've been around a lot longer than you.

fc3a9432.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

63879b13.text: Well then, it's better with you than it is with anyone else.

6531bc0a.text: I agree. I like it this way, too. Really, I do.

bc19b92f.text: Does it bother you that i know so much about what you do?

59baa3ce.text: the switch says, after a while:

586d6291.text: No. What makes you think I'd want you to know?

ac863c55.text: Why should it? Why should anyone have to know that?

de0b004d.text: I never said anything like that. You're the one who's always saying things like that.

866d5ab1.text: i say, because there's nothing else to say:

6d72081d.text: Well then, it's better in the long run with you than it is with anybody else.

64a4c601.text: I agree. I like it best when I do things myself.

21bfa756.text: But how can that be when you're always telling people to do stuff?

a3c50203.text: the switch says, after a while:

08732d68.text: I don't know. But that's just what I do.

1769b209.text: You know, you can never tell anybody to do anything.

e1e19d2e.text: You don't even know what you're talking about. Who do you think you are, anyway?
